title: Thorns and Thistles
summary: Thorns and thistles represent hardship in cultivation and often symbolize curse, fruitlessness, danger, or choking distraction.
background: Thorns appear after the fall and in parables and prophetic images. They can communicate difficulty, judgment, or spiritual choking.
teachingHelp: Ask whether thorns are literal agricultural hardship or a symbolic warning in the passage.
